name: Nullframe SynthAdapt Urban Complete Rig
description:
Designed for synthetic body proportions — elongated limb ratios, non-standard joint placement, torso geometry that no human tailor accounts for. Modular paneled top in deep indigo with contrast bone-white seaming, attaches via tension-clip rather than traditional closures. Matching wide-leg trousers with adjustable inseam extensions and reconfigurable waistband geometry. A structured drape coat in charcoal completes the silhouette, cut with deliberate asymmetry that reads as fashion on a synthetic frame.

All closures are tool-free reconfigurable. No fabric bunching at non-human joints. Soles are pressure-mapped to non-standard gait profiles.
functionality: Full modular reconfiguration for non-human proportions, tension-clip closures (no buttons or zippers to stress at unusual angles), pressure-mapped soles for non-standard gait, adjustable inseam extensions, and drape coat with asymmetric cut that flatters non-human torso geometry.
what_it_says: You refuse to wear clothes designed for a body you don't have — this was made for you, not adapted for you.
worn_by: human allies who commission matching pieces as solidarity statement
story_hooks: This exact colorway — indigo and bone-white — has been adopted as an informal symbol of synthetic civil rights organizing in Circuit district.
A synthetic wearing this is stopped repeatedly by CorpSec who insist their papers are forged — the outfit makes them look too 'intentional' to be a service unit.
Nullframe's lead designer is a synthetic who was previously property of a Tier 5 fashion house; every piece they make is a quiet act of reclamation.

physical_description.visual_profile: A striking, otherworldly silhouette that celebrates non-human anatomy. The deep indigo modular top creates clean geometric lines with bone-white contrast seaming that highlights elongated proportions. Wide-leg trousers flow with intentional asymmetry, and the charcoal drape coat adds architectural drama—all designed to emphasize synthetic body geometry rather than conceal it. Reads as high-fashion statement piece, not adaptive camouflage.
physical_description.fit: Precision-engineered for synthetic anthropomorphic frames: exaggerated limb channels, articulated joint accommodation, reconfigurable torso geometry. Deliberately loose through the legs with strategic compression at non-standard pivot points. The coat drapes asymmetrically, longer on one side, emphasizing the wearer's non-human proportions as an aesthetic feature.
physical_description.primary_material: Performance synth-wool blend with ballistic composite paneling at stress points. Pressure-mapped synthetic sole material engineered for non-standard gait mechanics. High-grade, expensive technical fabrics.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost liquid-looking synth-wool with subtle ribbed detailing on seams. Contrast bone-white seaming is raised and tactile. Coat features a soft drape with internal structural ribbing visible at asymmetrical cut edges.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep indigo (primary) with bone-white contrast seaming throughout. Charcoal drape coat provides neutral anchor. Minimal branding—design speaks louder than logos.
physical_description.closures: Tool-free tension-clip system (no traditional zippers or buttons). Reconfigurable magnetic snap points along inseam extensions. Friction-fit collar on coat, adjustable waistband geometry via intuitive friction fasteners.
distinctive_features: Modular paneled construction explicitly designed for synthetic joint architecture
Bone-white contrast seaming that maps non-human proportions
Reconfigurable inseam extensions with pressure-mapped adjustment
Asymmetrical drape coat that celebrates rather than hides non-standard silhouette
Pressure-mapped sole geometry for non-standard gait profiles
No fabric bunching or binding at synthetic joints
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury. This is bespoke corpo wear for the wealthy—or rebellious synth units with access to corpo resources. The technical precision and material cost place it firmly in the upper economic strata.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by synthetic corporate operatives, upmarket androidal service units, or renegade synth collectives with serious backing. Statement of pride in non-human identity—rejection of 'passing' aesthetics. Signals tech-forward, post-human values.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new. Shows minimal wear even with regular use due to advanced material durability. Any patching would be deliberate design modification, not damage repair.
